Verification.md must re-anchor test-only findings on the guarded production contract rather than file path, requiring tree-state demonstration or escape_input reasoning to classify harm reachability
SKILL.md frontmatter description must insert 'oracle strength,' into the discovery topic list after 'oversized units,' and remain under the 1024-character limit
